# Version 4.155.0
> **Skia and HarfBuzz upgrades** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews Skia m155 with HarfBuzz 14.4.0. The bundled shaping engine changes cross-direction mark positioning and improves malformed-font handling. RAW/DNG decoding is retired; Ganesh failed-flush cleanup and Linux font-family matching are corrected.

## Breaking Changes

- **Built-in RAW and DNG decoding removed** — RAW/DNG development and extraction of embedded JPEG previews are no longer supported. Use a separate RAW decoder or convert files before loading them. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng retains its value of 10 for compatibility, but does not indicate codec support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))
- **HarfBuzz mark positioning can change** — HarfBuzz 14.4 intentionally changes cross-direction mark positioning for DirectWrite and Core Text compatibility. Review text layouts and rendering baselines that depend on the previous shaping output. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to m155** — Advances the renderer while preserving rotation-scale text-run bounds and the existing managed and C API surface. ([#5081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5081))
- **HarfBuzz updated to 14.4.0** — Includes glyph-position saturation, malformed-font crash and hang fixes, and shaping and subsetting performance work. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))

## API Surface

- **OpenType tag enums** — Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enum values. Raw OpenType fetch functions remain internal; no Face wrappers are introduced. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))

## Bug Fixes

- **Failed-flush cache cleanup and Linux font ranking** — Clears uniquely held cache entries after a failed Ganesh flush. Fontconfig checks family acceptability only on the first valid sorted candidate instead of accepting a lower-ranked substitute. ([#5286](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5286))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0

Updates the native shaping engine to HarfBuzz 14.4.0, including cross-direction mark-positioning changes, glyph-position saturation, malformed-font fixes, and performance work. Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums without public raw-fetch wrappers.

## Release Candidate 1 (October 12, 2026)

The release candidate corrected Ganesh cache cleanup after failed flushes and Linux fontconfig first-candidate matching.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13...v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8)
